answers.redirect_misuse: open redirect / phishing via trusted domain
answers.idempotency: same action twice = same safe result; retries must not double-process

decisions.project_layout_reasoning: Worker in Module 07 must share types with API; shared package prevents drift; each app keeps own Dockerfile; avoids future monorepo migration.

bug.root_cause: HealthController route prefix changed from 'health' to 'healthz'

decisions.database_reasoning: Hottest query is a single-row lookup by code (needs UNIQUE constraint for dedupe); analytics need GROUP BY aggregation over clicks; clicks are a separate table with FK to links. Relational model matches these patterns exactly; no need for document-store flexibility.

indexes.Link.code: UNIQUE b-tree - exact redirect lookup (WHERE code = $1) + duplicate prevention
indexes.ClickEvent(linkId, clickedAt): composite b-tree - per-link time-range analytics aggregation

infra.postgres: docker container upsk-sdf-postgres, postgres:16, host port 5433 (host PostgreSQL 18 service occupies 5432), db upsk_sdf
infra.redis: docker container upsk-sdf-redis, redis:7-alpine, port 6379 (for Module 6)

bug.category: missing index on frequently queried field
bug.symptom: EXPLAIN on redirect query -> Seq Scan (cost 0.00..55.03), 2001 rows filtered, despite code being the hottest lookup
bug.root_cause: Link_code_key UNIQUE index dropped from live DB while schema still declared @unique on code (silent schema/database drift)
bug.fix: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Link_code_key" ON "Link"("code") to restore DB to match committed schema
bug.regression: Index Scan using Link_code_key (cost 0.28..8.29, rows=1); duplicate code insert rejected; prisma migrate status clean

api.create: POST /links {long_url, expires_at?, tags?} -> 201 {id, code, short_url, long_url, created_at}
api.redirect: GET /r/:code -> 302 + Location; 404 generic, no internal leaks
api.validation: SafeHttpUrl: trim, reject control chars/backslashes/userinfo/encoded-scheme/encoded-slash/scheme-relative; http/https only; expires_at future; tags <=10x32

bug.symptom: javascript:alert(1) and data:text/html payloads returned 201 and were STORED (previously 400)
bug.regression: abuse payloads -> 400 again; valid URL -> 201; poisoned rows deleted

decisions.auth_method_reasoning: JWT with 1h expiry over static API keys: expiry self-heals leaked tokens, claims carry sub identity for authorization rules (owner scoping, admin surface), stateless verification.

reflection.security_practice: Authorization must be enforced per-resource (createdBy scoping), not just per-route; JWT proves identity, not access rights.
reflection.risk: auth without per-object authorization + rate limits
reflection.mitigation: owner scoping on every user-scoped read/delete + verified JWT signature/claims

bug.symptom: user B (non-owner) GET /links/2089 -> 200 with owner A's full payload (should be 404)
bug.root_cause: findOneForUser dropped createdBy filter (findFirst {id, createdBy} -> findUnique {id})
bug.fix: restored createdBy: userId scoping in findOneForUser
bug.regression: user B -> 404, user A -> 200; no-auth -> 401, valid JWT -> 200

decisions.error_strategy_reasoning: Redirect hot path must never 500 on non-critical dependency failure - fall back to DB; analytics queue down must not block redirects (queue errors caught + logged). Fail-fast reserved for input validation (400) and boot-time config.

reflection.logging_rule: Never let log fields and response bodies share the same trust boundary - enforce redaction at BOTH layers (pino redact paths + no raw header fields in logger context).
reflection.risk: mystery hangs without explicit timeouts/readiness checks
reflection.mitigation: requestId correlation + latencyMs logging + envelope on every 4xx/5xx

bug.category: PII logged in error message — injected
bug.symptom: sentinel DO_NOT_LOG_ME_123 in Authorization header appeared verbatim in server logs after 401
bug.root_cause: AllExceptionsFilter warn branch logged raw authorizationHeader field
bug.fix: removed authorizationHeader from warn log context; pino redact covers headers
bug.regression: sentinel absent from post-fix logs; health 200; envelopes still carry requestId

decisions.cache_strategy_reasoning: Reads dominate (redirect hot path); writes are rare (create/PATCH/DELETE). Cache-aside: miss -> DB -> populate with TTL; every mutation invalidates link:code:<code> + link:id:<id>. Write-through adds a Redis write to every mutation for zero read benefit and still needs delete invalidation.

reflection.new_failure_mode: Stale-data serving when a mutation path forgets invalidation (silent until TTL) — cache-aside's control = responsibility; plus thundering herd on cold key under concurrency spike.
reflection.risk: cache stampede on cold key + stale data after missed invalidation
reflection.mitigation: single-flight coalescing (inflight Map per code) + TTL 3600 self-heal; invalidation in BOTH updateForUser and removeForUser; fail-fast ioredis (connectTimeout 2000, maxRetriesPerRequest 1, enableOfflineQueue false) with DB fallback (x-cache: DOWN) and auto-reconnect

bug.category: thundering herd on cache miss — injected
bug.symptom: 30 concurrent cold-key redirects (DEL link:code:q4CBGI) -> 5 parallel DB loads of the same row (instrumented [herd-instrument] DB load #1..#5)
bug.root_cause: findByCode had no request coalescing: every cache miss issued its own DB query
bug.fix: single-flight via Map<code, Promise> so concurrent misses share one DB load; map cleared in finally
bug.regression: 30 concurrent -> exactly 1 DB load; PATCH invalidation still serves new URL (x-cache MISS)

decisions.jobs_strategy_reasoning: Redirect is the hot path — inline writes make redirect latency hostage to database latency and pool exhaustion. Clicks are append-only telemetry where availability > immediate consistency. FlowProducer DLQ + unique dedupeKey provides reliability and idempotency.

reflection.operational_risk: Producer/worker decoupling hides failures until jobs are silently lost or double-processed (missing DLQ, non-idempotent worker, queue-name mismatch).
reflection.risk: poisoned jobs silently lost + double-counted retries
reflection.mitigation: FlowProducer DLQ + DlqWorker alert counter + sha256 dedupeKey UNIQUE constraint + createMany skipDuplicates + retention purge

bug.symptom: Poisoned job exhausted 3 retries and sat in failed queue with zero alerting
bug.root_cause: Missing dead-letter queue routing and worker monitoring on permanent job failures
bug.fix: FlowProducer DLQ (parent in clicks-dlq, child in clicks) + dlq.worker.ts with DLQ ALERT logging and redis dlq:alert:count increment
bug.regression: Poisoned job triggers dlq alert count 1->3; normal redirects record clicks 3->5
